source_title: Aaron Chen Announces Encore Australian Tour Following Sold-Out Run - Variety Australia
source_excerpt:
Australian comedian Aaron Chen is giving fans another chance to catch his latest stand-up show, “Technology,” announcing a string of encore performances across the country later this year.
Following a sold-out run across Australia and New Zealand, Chen will bring the show back to seven cities throughout November and December, with stops in Newcastle, Thirroul, Canberra, Darwin, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney.
The encore tour kicks off at Newcastle’s Civic Theatre on November 26th before wrapping up at Sydney’s State Theatre on December 17th. See full dates below.
Tickets will go on sale at 2pm on Monday, November 2nd, following a Live Nation presale from 1pm on Friday, October 30th. All times are local. Sign up for presale here .
In “Technology,” Chen brings his signature deadpan humour and unconventional observations to the absurdities of modern life, offering his own take on a world that seems to be getting increasingly complicated.
The comedian has become one of Australia’s most recognisable comedy exports in recent years, building a loyal following through his appearances in “Fisk” and “Guy Montgomery’s Guy Mont-Spelling Bee,” as well as his Netflix stand-up special “Funny Garden.” Globally, his popularity continues to grow too.
